name: The St. Regis Amman
positioning: St. Regis hotel in Amman's 5th Circle with butler service, a rooftop restaurant and a spa offering Dead Sea treatments
best_for: City travelers who want St. Regis butler service in Amman
Food and cocktail lovers, from the rooftop Zenith to the Jameed Mary

facts.text: The hotel is in Amman's 5th Circle area, on Shafiq Al Hayek Street.
Segreta is tucked within an indoor garden and serves Italian-led cuisine alongside French and Californian classics.
Tamara serves mezze, Jordanian specialties and grilled meats, indoors or on the terrace by the pool.
Mercado is reserved for in-house guests and serves an international breakfast buffet with live cooking stations.
The Tea Lounge serves fine teas, light refreshments and afternoon tea.
Rooms have Frette linens and the St. Regis Signature Bed.
Every room includes a marble bathroom.
The Royal Suite, on the high floors, has a private balcony with skyline views, a full kitchen and three bathrooms.
The two-bedroom suite has a fully equipped kitchenette and a private balcony with city views.
Guests can reach an E-Butler through a live WhatsApp chat.
Butlers offer complimentary pressing for up to two garments.
The hotel has an outdoor pool.

highlights.text: The St. Regis Bar sits behind a 24k gold mural and serves craft cocktails.
The hotel's local take on the Bloody Mary is the Jameed Mary, with savory notes echoing Bedouin tradition.
Deluxe Rooms use earthy tones with rose and orange details that recall the landscapes of Wadi Rum.
The St. Regis Spa offers Dead Sea treatments, a couples suite and a Thermal Suite with sauna, steam room and jacuzzi.
Zenith is a rooftop restaurant and outdoor lounge with panoramic city views.

considerations.text: Queen Alia International Airport is about 35.2 km away, and the hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
Self-parking is not available; complimentary valet parking is provided for all guests.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
